name: End Of Day Requirement 1
definition: Obligations of a clearing member with respect to a central counterparty that are calculated based on end of day positions.

InitialMarginRequirement.name: Initial Margin Requirement
InitialMarginRequirement.definition: Specifies the initial margin requirement for position.

VariationMarginRequirement.name: Variation Margin Requirement
VariationMarginRequirement.definition: Daily change in mark-to-market for the associated position. Indicates whether variation margin paid to clearing members (true) or received from clearing members (false).

MarginPresenceRule.definition: At least one margin (initial or variation) must be present.
